title: National Park Explorer
description: Every National Park Service unit on one map. Click a park for when it was created, how big it is, and how many people visited last year.

title: World XI
description: A globe of more than 5,000 soccer clubs, each sitting on its home stadium.

title: The Century of Africa
description: Africa's population will roughly triple this century. This story map asks whether power, water, and roads will keep up.

title: Torn Down / Built Back
description: Which Detroit blocks were torn down and which were built back, from 1870 to now.

title: Train Route Atlas
description: Twelve famous train routes on a spinning globe, with a short note on each.

title: State Extremes
description: The northernmost, southernmost, easternmost, and westernmost points of every US state and every country.

title: Geopuesto Playground
description: A sandbox for drawing shortest paths and other curves on a globe.

title: U.S. Fantasy Transit Network
description: A made-up US transit map that connects cities at four scales, from coast-to-coast down to commuter.

title: Concord Civil War
description: A story map about an imagined civil war that splits Concord, New Hampshire along the river.

title: Bug Wars
description: Build a bug colony and try not to get eaten.

title: Bottle Game
description: Flick a bottle for a clean flip. Land it upright to steal a life. Win a game and unlock the parrot.

title: Whydah's Voyage
description: Sail Black Sam Bellamy's 1717 trip from the Caribbean to Maine. Ten missions, then the storm that sank the ship.

title: True Scale
description: See how big a place really is when you move it to another latitude.

title: Sequential Interstate Challenge
description: A driving order for every two-digit Interstate that cuts most of the extra connecting miles.

title: Mapzimus Board
description: A scoreboard of about 20,000 map ideas, ranked by how well they might travel.

title: Boston in Motion
description: Trains, buses, ferries, planes, harbor boats, and bikes, all moving on one Boston map right now.

title: Where the Games Go
description: Where North Shore Nostalgia eBay packages have gone, drawn as routes from Salem.

title: SmartPicker
description: Pick students fairly. Random, balanced, or reach-the-quiet. Nothing leaves the browser.

title: Predicting Tomorrow's Housing Crisis
description: A work-in-progress map of Massachusetts housing pressure, with sliders you can move.

title: LEHS Math
description: The math site I built for Lynn English High School. Student and teacher pages, thirty-plus tools, and the MCAS question bank.

title: WhydahStory
description: The Whydah Gally for the classroom. The ship, the wreck off Cape Cod, the maps, and the people.

title: MathDOKtor
description: A site about depth of knowledge in math class. How hard a question really is, not just whether the answer is right.

title: howe2math
description: Printable Pre-Algebra, Algebra 1, and Geometry worksheets. Two minutes, then print.

title: Tappymaps Arcade
description: Color US states and counties, then play geography games on the same maps.

title: Citynario
description: A Lynn planning toy. Change a budget or a rule and see what that does to the city.

title: Ground Truth
description: Terrain notes for wooded land. Public data, drone lidar, and a map you can use before you buy or build.

title: Quabbin
description: The Quabbin Reservoir and the towns it drowned, with pictures, a fill animation, and a lidar view of what's left on the ground.

title: LEHS Data Dive
description: Lynn school data next to peer districts, using state education numbers.

title: Elevation Studio
description: A 3D terrain workshop. Load real hills, trace rivers, and flood a valley. Still being built.

title: Optitrek
description: A US road-trip planner that picks a route through hundreds of national parks. Still being built.

title: Hurricane Impact Lab
description: A what-if hurricane map. Drop a storm on a city and see a story version and a numbers version. Still being built.

title: Game Vault
description: Every North American release on 19 old consoles, with box art, so you can build a list and watch the disk space.
